text:
anya: quick heads-up from the sample app tests: on Android 14 emulator OkHttp dropping Authorization on 307 redirect when followRedirects=true. Works on Android 11.
diego: hmm. interceptor placement? app vs network interceptor?
anya: simple auth interceptor we ship in samples (adds Authorization header) and client is OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(true).addInterceptor(auth).build()
mike: try .header(...) instead of addHeader — that fixed a similar oddity for me.
anya: swapped to .header(...) and the small repro with MockWebServer passes on the emulator.
infra-bot: created INF-4288: "Auth header lost on 3xx redirect (emulator-14)" and attached minimal repro.
olivia: moving to addNetworkInterceptor preserves header but breaks our Authenticator refresh flow since the Authenticator logic expects app-interceptor context.
diego: short-term docs: add README note and recommend .header(...) or followRedirects(false) + manual redirect handling. Add CI job to run emulator-14 in sample matrix.
anya: i'll open a tiny PR with the MockWebServer test + README blurb. will ping for device validation. :thumbsup:
